undefeated Rockets past Bucks, 132-100</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401909887</link><description>— Fred VanVleet scored 24 points and Amen Thompson added 23 as the Houston Rockets remained undefeated with a 132-100 rout of the Milwaukee Bucks on Wednesday night.</description><pubDate>Thu, 29 Oct 2026 02:44:50 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://s.espncdn.com/stitcher/sports/basketball/nba/events/401909887.png?templateId=espn.applewatch.awayhome.1" /></item><item><title>Nikola Jokic notches 200th career triple-double as the Nuggets down the Pelicans, 104-91</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401909889</link><description>— Nikola Jokic had 21 points, 13 rebounds and 10 assists for his 200th career triple-double in the regular season, and the Denver Nuggets never trailed in a 104-91 victory over the winless New Orleans Pelicans on Wednesday night.</description><pubDate>Thu, 29 Oct 2026 02:43:47
